results.title: Optimizing health-related quality of life assessments for ...
results.content: # Optimizing health-related quality of life assessments for stroke survivors: a validation study of psychometric properties for the Vietnamese version of stroke impact scale 3.0. While the Stroke Impact Scale (SIS) 3.0 is a widely validated instrument for evaluating health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in stroke survivors, its psychometric properties have not yet been examined in the Vietnamese context. The robust psychometric properties of the refined V-SIS 3.0 suggest that essential aspects of HRQoL in stroke survivors can be captured with fewer items, facilitating quicker assessments without compromising reliability or validity. This study provides compelling evidence that the V-SIS 3.0 is a reliable and valid tool for assessing HRQoL in Vietnamese stroke survivors. Citation: Nguyen TTP, Hoang HB, Vu HTT and Lee SW (2025) Optimizing health-related quality of life assessments for stroke survivors: a validation study of psychometric properties for the Vietnamese version of stroke impact scale 3.0.
